How long does a kettle take to boil?

Published January 1, 2027

On a gas hob a full 1.7 L stovetop kettle takes about six minutes. Induction is quicker, and an electric coil is slower. The exact time depends on the starting temperature of the water and the size of the burner.

In our tests induction was 2x quicker than an electric coil.
